title: The Pack Den
text: Under the roots of a great tree is a den, where a litter of pups with eyes like coals tumble over each other, growling in small voices. The bones around the den are fresh. The mother is out hunting, though not far.

options.label: The Leader takes a pup to raise, before the mother comes home.

outcomes.text: It bites, then settles, then follows. It will grow into a great hound, or something else.

options.label: Leave the pups and go quietly; no mother forgives a stolen child.

outcomes.text: An hour later the mother passes you on the path, bloody to the shoulder. She only looks.

options.label: Wait by the den for the mother, and kill her when she comes home.
